rv.q: The actors are so good that it would be unfair to single out one when all are worthy of the highest praise.
Notwithstanding, as first-rate productions of equally first-rate plays go, PURPOSE is an exemplar.
This is a world-class production that deserves every bit of praise it receives.
It's a masterclass on acting, directing and playwriting, and not to be missed.
The Broadway/Steppenwolf Theatre Company production of Purpose is as great as it gets.
Whether or not you see your own reflected in the Jaspers, you’ll feel the ache of recognition all the same.
Branden Jacobs-Jenkins' Purpose turns that tension into a gripping, often unexpectedly funny drama in which political conviction, parental love and personal ambition become difficult to separate.

cn.t: Critics largely rave about Purpose, praising Phylicia Rashad's direction and a powerhouse ensemble cast. A few note the script has minor flaws, but most find Branden Jacobs-Jenkins' Pulitzer-winning family drama gripping and emotionally resonant.
